rules.title: Rules
rules.rule1: Players take turns placing their symbol (X or O) on an empty cell.
rules.rule2: Whoever forms a line of three loses the round.
rules.rule3: This applies horizontally, vertically and diagonally.
rules.rule4: If all cells are filled without a line of three, the game ends in a draw.
rules.sketchAlt: Sketch from the assignment: example of a line of three
rules.adessoAria: Go to the adesso website (opens in a new tab)

menu.overwrite: The game {{a}} vs {{b}} (started on {{date}}) will be overwritten.

tutorial.step1: Here you can see which player moves next.
tutorial.step2: This is the board. Place your mark on an empty cell. The goal is to avoid forming a line of three.
tutorial.step3: Here you can start a new game at any time.
tutorial.step4: The crown always marks the player with the highest score. Below it you can see the move history of both players.
tutorial.step5: O plays C4. This move doesn't complete a line of three yet, so the game continues.
tutorial.step6: X plays A4, which forms the line A4–B3–C2! Whoever forms a line of three loses. O wins the game!
